title: a11y broker detection
desc: Pre/post broker detection for a11y actions: detect blocking nodes (modal/alert/dialog/overlay) with full grap + content before and after every a11y action
steps: IMPLEMENTATION: in ActionExecutor.cs (or a11y command pipeline), add pre/post broker scan. Pre: before action execute, call BrokerScan(scope). Post: after action, call BrokerScan(scope) again, diff against pre-scan, output NEW brokers only. BrokerScan returns List<BrokerNode> with (Grap, Type, Role, Name, Content). Print each as [BROKER:PRE/POST]. Zero brokers = silent (no output). Non-zero = print and continue (do NOT abort -- let caller decide). Performance: UIA scope scan with 500ms timeout, CDP eval with 300ms timeout.

BROKER OUTPUT FORMAT: [BROKER:PRE] or [BROKER:POST] + full grap + UIA type + element name + text content. Example: [BROKER:PRE] grap={hwnd:0x1234,proc:chrome,domain:chatgpt.com}#Doc/Dlg_Login type=Dialog name=LoginRequired content=Please log in [OK][Cancel]. Full grap must be copy-paste ready for a11y invoke/click.

BROKER DETECTION PATTERNS -- UIA: ControlType=Dialog with IsModal=true, Name matches confirm/cancel/allow/deny/accept/cookie/captcha/permission/alert. Web CDP: [role=dialog], [role=alertdialog], .modal, .overlay, cookie-banner, consent elements. Performance: UIA scan 500ms timeout, CDP eval 300ms timeout.

IMPLEMENTATION: in a11y action pipeline pre/post hooks. Pre: BrokerScan before action execute. Post: BrokerScan after action, diff against pre-scan, output NEW brokers only with [BROKER:POST]. Zero brokers = silent. Non-zero = print and continue (do NOT abort -- caller decides). Output zero-alloc if no broker found.
author: claude
